author: claude
design: One registry file (RESEARCH-STREAMS.json, schema_version 1; streams with stream_id, question_id, status active|inactive|retired; retired needs retired_at/by/reason; unique ids). Absent file = R5 behaviour. Unusable file = UNKNOWN: existing incidents and R5 top-question coverage kept, reason carried in every notice. Registry mode watches active streams plus every question that already has an incident; each has its own clock, rest and incident (state keyed by question id, so migration keeps clocks). A package quiets only its bound question in worker/verify; a record stream_id that disagrees with the registry is a contradictory binding. Removal without retirement keeps the incident; explicit retirement resolves only that stream via escalation-resolve. Ladder, ledger, dedupe, service and timer unchanged (units byte-identical to R5).
tests: 37/37: 24 R5 cases unchanged + 13 R11 (one active/one stalled lower-ranked, inactive untracked, independent rest+expiry, cross-binding, A package does not quiet B, removed stream keeps incident, retirement resolves only its stream, retirement without fields = bad registry, two clocks through restarts, bad registry owned, unknown status/duplicates bad, migration keeps legacy clock, no package either stream)
planted_faults: 27/27 caught (20 R5 + 7 R11; one R5 anchor re-pointed to the new binding line, same fault)
dry_run: read-only on real priorities/status/REST with sandbox state and stub transports, with and without the proposed registry: both 'Q-WORK-BENEFIT: ok (rest to 15:25:44Z)'
limits: B stays inactive in the proposed registry; activating it is a director step
real calendar-timer witness and install held for the post-review slot
a stream whose rest expires between ticks starts its clock at the next tick (same +5 min bound as R5)
not_done: no install, no registry created in campaign4, no Signal, no seats
